A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Before you
get started.

Where do physical classes take place?+

Classes take place at EduPen Banani: House # 58/B, Road # 21, Kemal Ataturk Ave, Dhaka 1213. The map link points to the same building. Confirm the classroom and arrival details with EduPen.

Can I take a trial class?+

Yes. Both featured teachers' October batches offer a free trial class. Contact EduPen directly to confirm a suitable session and availability.

Are online courses available yet?+

Not yet. Online lectures are coming soon. This website currently introduces our teachers and in-person classes.

What about A Levels and IELTS?+

A Levels and IELTS are part of Prosper Academy's planned course offering. Teachers, schedules, and enrolment details will be announced when those courses are ready.
